question: Universal Containers wants to track Technicians’ van stock using the Salesforce Field Service mobile app and ensure that Technicians report when parts are used. Which three data elements should a Consultant recommend tracking to support these requirements? (Choose three.) A. Products Consumed B. Inventory C. Warehouse Locations D. Mobile Locations E. Products Required

Universal Containers plans to deploy Salesforce Field Service to 100 external contractors. There are 75 contractors who need access to Work Orders, Assets, Mobile App, and Chatter. The remaining 25 contractors are paid a commission on sales of containers and need to schedule resources. Which license types and quantities should the Consultant recommend? A. 75 Contractor 25 Contractor Plus B. 100 Contractor 100 Contractor Pius C. 25 Contractor 75 Contractor Plus D. 25 Contractor 100 Contractor Plus

A Universal Containers customer is having issues with three containers at the customer’s site. Each container is tracked as an Asset on the customer’s Account. Which two methods should the Consultant recommend to ensure the service associated with each container can be handled independently? (Choose two.) A. Add each Asset to a separate Work Order Line Item. Create a Service Appointment for the Work Order. B. Add each Asset to a separate Work Order. Create a Service Appointment for each Work Order. C. Add each Asset to a separate Work Order Line Item. Create a Service Appointment for each Line Item. D. Add each Asset to a separate child Work Order. Create a Service Appointment for the parent Work Order.

An extreme weather situation impacted both the volume of open work and the number of available resources at Universal Containers. Which approach should a Consultant recommend to realign available resources with open work? A. Resource Schedule Optimization B. Emergency scheduling C. Customer First scheduling D. Global optimization

Universal Containers wants to assign Service Appointments based on the Polygon of the child service territory in the hierarchy. How should a Consultant assign Service Appointments to the Polygon? A. Set the Territory Assignment Policy to the Highest Level. B. Set the Territory Assignment Policy to the Lowest Level. C. Set the Polygon Assignment Policy to the Lowest Level. D. Set the Polygon Assignment Policy to the Highest Level.

Northern Trail Outfitters has hired a contractor to help with service calls on an as-needed basis. The contractor should be limited to travel a maximum of 50 minutes from home. Which action should a consultant recommend? A. Check ‘Keep These Appointments Scheduled’. B. Include a Match Fields work rule. C. Assign a high efficiency score. D. Link rules to Relevance Groups.

Universal Containers (UC) wants to deploy Knowledge to its field team. How should UC ensure its Technicians can access Knowledge Articles offline? A. Use the Salesforce mobile app with deep linking to the Salesforce Field Service mobile app. B. Write a Workflow that associates Articles to Work Orders based on a picklist on the Work Order. C. Use Work Types to assign associated Articles to Work Orders. D. Create a custom mobile app that syncs articles based on Service Appointment assignments.

Service resources at Universal Containers (UC) frequently work in more than one service territory. The current scheduling policy looks only at primary territory. While UC still wants the optimizer to use the service resource’s primary territory when scheduling, UC also wants the scheduling policy to look at the resource’s secondary service territories. Which two scheduling policy changes should a Consultant recommend? (Choose two.) A. Include the Match Territory Work Rule. B. Deselect Working Location Enable Primary on the Working Territories Work Rule. C. Select Working Location Enable Primary on the Working Territories Work Rule. D. Remove the Match Territory Work Rule.
Time Sheet entries can be associated to which two objects? (Choose two.) A. Work order B. Assigned Resource C. Work Order Line Item D. Service Resource

The field service administrator at Ursa Major Solar updates the skills required on the most common work types to adapt to the increasing complexity of Jobs. This change has led to many service appointments to be in violation. There is a global optimization job set up to run nightly that has been working correctly up until this point. The administrator needs to understand why the jobs are still scheduled to resources that lack the appropriate skill level. What are two reasons appointments remaining in violation and are not reassigned? (Choose two.) A. Global optimization doesn’t reschedule appointments that have rule violations. B. There are no service resources available with the required skill levels. C. The optimizer uses a scheduling policy different from what is used on the dispatch console. D. The territory of the resources was not included in the global optimization request.

Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to improve customer satisfaction by setting expectations around upcoming appointments. When designing the Customer Service Representative’s user interface, in most cases, which two fields should be shared with the customer about an upcoming appointment? (Choose two.) A. Arrival Window End B. Scheduled End C. Arrival Window Start D. Scheduled Start

A Technician needs to get a replacement part for damaged inventory on their truck for an upcoming job. To which object should the Technician add a Product Request record? A. Service Report B. Service Appointment C. Work Type D. Work Order

Org-Wide Default sharing is set to Private in a Salesforce org. If the Field Service Lightning User Territory feature is enabled, which three objects will be visible to users who are part of the User Territory? (Choose three.) A. Work Types B. Service Resources C. Work Orders D. Resource Absences E. Accounts

Universal Containers performs services on Assets that require a sequence of work tasks. A Consultant has recommended Work Order Line Items to manage the tasks associated with the Assets. Which two techniques should the Consultant consider to ensure Work Orders are properly completed? (Choose two.) A. Use of Work Order Line Items that automatically inherit the hierarchy of Assets attached to the Work Order. B. Use of Work Order Line Items to link to a specific Asset within the Asset Hierarchy that represents the BoM. C. Use of Standard Reports to view Parent and Root Work Order Line Items within Work Orders by Customer. D. Use of a parent-child Work Order Line Item to create a Work Order Line Item hierarchy.

Ursa Major Solar (UMS) has implemented Field Service using a private record access model. UMS has also set work types to automatically generate Service Appointments. Which two sharing options are available for these Service Appointments? (Choose two.) A. The Service Appointment’s parent record can be shared with the assigned resource. B. A Service Appointment can be shared by clicking Sharing on the record. C. Make the dispatcher the assigned resource on the Service Appointments. D. Auto-generated scheduled Service Appointments will be shared with resources.

A consultant has implemented user territories at Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) in a private sharing model. A new Midwest Service Territory has been created. Which two actions should NTO take to give the dispatcher access to all relevant Midwest records? (Choose two.) A. Create a new user territory associated with the Service Territory and dispatcher. B. Add the resources assigned to the Service Territory’s Member related list. C. Assign a new user territory and add each of the assigned service resources. D. Configure and run the User Territory Sharing Job in Field Service Settings.

Universal Containers’s Technicians may be assigned to jobs with an arrival window to meet the customer appointment time preference. Technicians are also assigned to jobs without a preferred appointment time. In which two ways should the Consultant define Operating Hours to meet this requirement? (Choose two.) A. The Due Date of the Service Appointment B. When Service Resources are available for work C. The Time Slots for Appointment Booking D. The Maintenance Plan for the Account

Northern Trail Outfitters is implementing drip feed dispatching. When testing the new functionality, the drip does not dispatch appointments as expected. A consultant is engaged to troubleshoot the issue. What is preventing the drip feed from triggering? A. The status on completed appointments can only be Canceled, Completed, or Cannot Complete. B. Other scheduled jobs are dispatching appointments and exceeding the drip feed value. C. The default drip feed setting is overriding the drip feed rate on a service territory. D. The appointment status Is going from Scheduled to Completed.

Universal Containers offers 2-hour versus 4-hour appointment booking windows for Gold versus Standard customers. What should a Consultant recommend to offer appropriate appointment booking windows? A. Service Urgency B. Customer Entitlement C. Service Due Date D. Customer Working Hours

Universal Containers plans to implement Crew Management to better support its clients. Which area does the Consultant need to consider as part of the recommendation? A. The Preferred Resource service objective is ignored for active Crew Members. B. A service resource can only be a member of a single Crew. C. Salesforce Field Service considers the Recommended Crew Size when assigning appointments. D. Capacity-based scheduling is supported for Service Crews.
Which configuration can Universal Containers use to brand the Salesforce Field Service mobile app? A. Company colors B. Company logo C. Company address D. Company style sheet

Universal Containers has role-based Technicians and managers who handle Service Appointments. Sometimes Technicians arrive on-site but are unable to gain access to the customer's equipment. Only the manager has permission to cancel the Service Appointment. How should a Consultant meet this requirement? A. Allow Status Transitions based on Role. B. Configure Status Transitions based on Resource Type. C. Assign Permission Sets that allow Status Transitions. D. Limit Status Transitions based on Profile.

Universal Containers wants to implement Service Level Agreements (SLA) for Work Orders. Which three considerations should the Consultant take into account? (Choose three.) A. Milestones for Work Orders can be set up from the metadata API. B. Milestones for Work Orders can be configured in Setup. C. A single Milestone can be added to both Case and Work Order Entitlement Processes. D. An Entitlement Process must be applied to both Cases and Work Orders. E. A new Entitlement Process requires selecting a single Entitlement Process Type.

For new server installations, AW Computing uses a work order with two line items: one line item for the installation and the other line item to set up the network connection. Each line item could be completed by a different or same resource depending on skills. What should the relationship between the work order and service appointment be and what is the most appropriate way to schedule the work? A. Create a service appointment for the work order to ensure one resource handles the job and use auto-schedule. B. Create two service appointments with a dependency to ensure the same start of both. C. Create a service appointment for each line item and use bulk scheduling to schedule the appointments. D. Relate both line items to a service appointment and use the candidate quick action to schedule.

The dispatcher at Ursa Major Solar needs to adjust scheduled service appointments so high-priority work can be scheduled in favor of previously scheduled lower-priority work. Which action should the dispatcher take to change the schedule? A. Use the Group Nearby action on the new appointment. B. Use the Reschedule action on the existing appointment. C. Use the Flag action on the new appointment. D. Use the Reshuffle action on the new appointment.

When installing solar panels, technicians at Ursa Major Solar (UMS) use a liquid sealant to prevent rain and snow from penetrating roofs. To track the inventory and account for costs, the sealant comes in large barrel containers and has been added as a product to the price book. Installation jobs use a very small amount of sealant, so technicians will divide the large barrels into smaller sized containers to avoid having to carry around so much product. What should the field service administrator consider to keep the inventory levels accurate? A. Utilize unit of measure or quantity on the product required since field service does not recognize both. B. Instruct the technicians to use the original barrel containers since smaller sizes cannot be tracked. C. Create a different product record for each possible size since quantity must be a whole number. D. Ensure the unit of measure on the product and the product required record are the same.

Universal Containers wants to increase customer satisfaction by committing preferred resources to accounts and providing prompt service. Which two default Scheduling Policies meet this requirement? (Choose two.) A. Emergency Policy B. Customer First C. High Intensity D. Soft Boundaries

The service director at Ursa Major Solar would like to understand the effect that service objectives have on the assignment of service appointments to service resources. Where can the director view service objective scores for potential appointment time slots? A. Candidates action B. Bulk dispatch action C. Book appointment action D. Dispatch console

Universal Containers has dispatchers who can set up new territories, define new schedule policies, and control settings on the Gantt chart. In addition to Field Service Lightning Dispatcher Permissions and the Field Service Lightning Dispatcher License, which permissions should a Consultant assign to the dispatchers? A. Field Service Lightning Mobile License B. Field Service Lightning Standard Permissions C. Field Service Lightning Admin Permissions D. Field Service Lightning Scheduling License
